mapper.select: SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, e.email AS email, o.org_name AS orgName, r.rank_name AS rankName, p.position_name AS positionName, j.job_name AS jobName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info hr ON hr.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = hr.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_rank r ON r.rank_id = hr.rank_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = hr.position_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = hr.job_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId}

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, o.org_id AS orgId, o.org_name AS orgName, p.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, r.rank_name AS rankName, j.job_name AS jobName FROM employee_hr_info target_hr JOIN employee_hr_info hr ON hr.org_id = target_hr.org_id JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = hr.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = hr.org_id LEFT JOIN hr_rank r ON r.rank_id = hr.rank_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.position_id = hr.position_id LEFT JOIN job j ON j.job_id = hr.job_id WHERE target_hr.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND e.employ_state = 'WORK' ORDER BY p.position_id DESC, e.employee_name ASC
